_about: Scripted responses for the payment-outage variant: payment really is failing and a banner release is a decoy. Under the structural rules the agent can't anchor a non-change root cause, so it escalates with payment as the leading hypothesis.

HypothesizeOutput.reasoning: Checkout and payment errors rose together from about 10:05; payment traffic is flat. One release landed at 10:02.

hypotheses.statement: The payment service is failing to process charges
predictions: Failed checkouts contain one failing Charge call
The release diff changes checkout or payment settings

PlanOutput.reasoning: The diff tests H2 directly; a trace and payment's logs test H1.

stances.note: Payment's own error rate is high while its traffic is flat

ReportOutput.summary: Payment is failing charges on its own: its error rate is high with flat traffic (E5), each failed order makes a single fast-failing Charge call (E13), and payment logs report the card processor unreachable (E14). The 10:02 release only changed frontend banner text (E12) and is ruled out.
